description: A creator-led Vietnamese soccer analysis foundation for evidence-led long-form episodes.
primary_publishing_shape: Long-form Vietnamese soccer analysis; platform publishing and platform-specific adaptations are not configured in this package.
renderer_requirement: Use the bundled Vietnamese type system, tonal pitch backdrop, orientation-correct tactical geometry, numbered shirt markers, story-specific focal-player accents, and sparse on-screen copy. No persistent narration subtitles. Keep real media in approved Asset Library slots.
change_policy: No per-content edits to locked design. Changes require a new package version and explicit owner review.
